The initial verdict of SUPPORTED remains unchanged. The evidence review confirms that E7, E8, and E9 all ENTAIL the claim with EXACT_MATCH or COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION period compatibility. E7 shows Q3 2026 revenue was $64,601 million, E8 shows Q3 2025 revenue was $51,242 million, and E9 provides the computed year-over-year growth of 26.07%, which exceeds the 20% threshold stated in the claim.

Challenge H1 (one-time items/acquisitions/accounting changes): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. The retrieved evidence (E10-E12) discusses tax rate changes, infrastructure costs, and general business metrics but does not indicate that the revenue growth was materially affected by one-time items, acquisitions, or accounting changes that would make the comparison misleading.

Challenge H2 (restatements): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. The numeric check confirms Q3 2025 revenue was $51,242 million (evidence E16, E17), matching the figure used in the original calculation. No restatement or correction was found.

Challenge H3 (discontinued operations): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. While E18 mentions held-for-sale assets and data center ventures, and E19-E20 discuss segment profitability, none of these passages indicate that the total revenue figure includes discontinued operations or segments that should be excluded from the year-over-year comparison.

All challenges were either refuted or found no relevant evidence to support them. The claim remains SUPPORTED.

Executive Overview of Second Quarter Results Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our financial results and key Family metrics for the second quarter of 2026 are set forth below. Total revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $60.80 billion, an increase of 28% compared to the second quarter of 2025, due to an increase in advertising revenue. Revenue on a constant currency basis would have increased 27% compared to the second quarter of 2025. Ad impressions delivered across our Family of Apps in the second quarter of 2026 increased 14% year-over-year, and our average price per ad in the second quarter of 2026 increased 12% year-over-year. Income from operations for the second quarter of 2026 was $18.78 billion, a decrease of $1.67 billion, or 8%, compared to the second quarter of 2025, driven by higher costs and expenses.
